purpose: Prevent the shared Codex app-server from retaining completed companion threads and exhausting file descriptors.
consumer: The user systemd manager and the shared Codex daemon.
contract: Hourly cleanup may unload only idle Codex Companion threads older than the configured age; active threads are never touched and the daemon is never restarted.
failureBoundary: A cleanup failure leaves the daemon and all threads running; it must not kill or restart the daemon.
evidence: node scripts/codex-thread-gc.mjs --age-hours=24; node --check scripts/codex-thread-gc.mjs; systemctl --user show codex-thread-gc.timer
falsifier: A cleanup run sends thread/unsubscribe to an active thread or restarts/kills the app-server.
invariants: Cleanup is idempotent for notLoaded threads

assumptions.value: thread/unsubscribe is the app-server unload operation
assumptions.falsifier: The daemon returns an unsupported-method error or leaves an idle thread loaded.

assumptions.value: Codex Companion threads identify as originator Codex Desktop and name prefix Codex Companion Task:
assumptions.falsifier: A live companion thread has different originator/name metadata.
